name: Samenai Akumu de Suki Desu ka?
original_name: 覚めない悪夢で好きですか?
source:
Born with burn marks covering her body, the reclusive and broken Setsuna Rajou finds solace in only one person—her childhood friend Misuzu Hongou.

And Misuzu loves her just as desperately in return.

Setsuna needs her.
Misuzu wants to save her.

"Setsuna-chan, in this nightmare we call the world...
Do you want to keep fighting through hell, screaming 'I want to live'?
Or would you rather choose... the freedom of 'death'?"

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/2208797]booth[/url]]
translation:
罗城刹那生来便满身烧伤疤痕，精神破碎、闭门不出。她唯一的慰藉，只有青梅竹马本乡美铃。

而美铃也同样近乎疯狂地爱着她。

刹那需要美铃。
美铃想拯救刹那。

“刹那，在这个被我们称为噩梦的世界里……
你想继续在地狱中挣扎，呼喊着‘我想活下去’吗？
还是宁愿选择……‘死亡’带来的解脱？”

[译自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/2208797]booth[/url]]
